s: Free weekly online credit reports are available from Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. Credit reports play an important role in your financial life and we encourage you to regularly check your credit history.

When you order your free TransUnion credit report, you’ll also have the option to order your free Equifax and Experian credit reports. The information in these reports can differ, so it’s good practice to review all three. For example, some lenders choose to report account data to only one or two credit reporting agencies, not all three.
